manifestations.description: persistent pain in his right knee (grade 6-7/10 at rest and up to 10/10 on walking)
uses a stick as walking aid
pain disturbing his sleep for 3 to 4 night a week
marked quadriceps wasting of his right knee
tenderness around the patella and medial femoral condyle
limitation of the end range of flexion and extension movement of his right knee

treatments_received: physiotherapy (August 2003 to March 2004, 3 times a week)
occupational therapy at Princess Margaret Hospital (April 2004 for 3 months, 3 times a week)
orthopaedic follow-up at Yan Chai Hospital and North District Hospital
treatments_future: ANA Review Clinic visits 8 times a year for 5 years

losses.description: Cannot return to his pre-injury job as a transportation worker; at best can only have sedentary jobs such as cashier or lift operator.
Has to use a stick as walking aid and has weakness of his right leg.
